name: Summarize This Page
description:
Get a short, skimmable summary of the page you're on — written on your device, no account.

**How it works:** Run now → Read the current page → Summarize it → Local AI model → Show the summary.

**Setup:**
- Install / enable the awflow browser extension.
- Local AI model: set model.

**Good for:** skimming a long article and catching the gist before committing your time.
setup: Install / enable the awflow browser extension.
